subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: For this PR, should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus source-level positive/negative coverage as sufficient proof for a provider-side xAI rotation error that the contributor says cannot be induced on demand?
rationale: ClawSweeper's external-PR proof gate normally requires after-fix real behavior proof, but the discussion plausibly explains that the exact provider error only appears during organic xAI model/key rotation.

options.title: Accept Proof Override
options.body: Apply a maintainer proof override and review/land the narrow predicate fix if the code remains clean at current head.

options.title: Wait For Organic Logs
options.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor or an operator captures a redacted after-fix xAI/Grok retry during a real rotation event.

options.title: Replace With Maintainer Patch
options.body: Close or supersede this PR only if maintainers want to carry an equivalent internal fix with their own proof path.

recommendation.title: Accept Proof Override
recommendation.body: Apply a maintainer proof override and review/land the narrow predicate fix if the code remains clean at current head.
